title: commander: add Option.deprecated() touching option, command and help
prompt: This is a copy of commander.js (lib/ and index.js). Add a chainable `Option.prototype.deprecated(message)` where `message` is an optional string. Contract: (1) when an option marked deprecated has its value processed from the command line or from its env var, the command writes `warning: option '<option.flags>' is deprecated` followed by `: <message>` only if a non-empty message was given, then a newline, through the command's configured `writeErr` output; parsing results are otherwise unchanged. (2) In generated help the option's description gets ` [deprecated]` appended, after any parenthesised extra info such as the default, for example `the old way (default: "a") [deprecated]`. Options that are not deprecated behave exactly as before.
